DISCOVER.TITLE: Discover Georgia
DISCOVER.companyabout: Discover Georgia is a digital tourism platform designed to unite specific locations, local businesses, events, and experiences across Georgia into a single digital space.We are building a modern ecosystem that connects tourists, local residents, and small businesses. The platform allows users to discover both popular and lesser-known spots, plan trips, and find new experiences.A key feature is user participation: individuals can add new locations, mark specific spots, upload photos and descriptions, and share their discoveries with others.This creates a community-driven tourism platform where people help one another uncover Georgia’s hidden gems and share them with the wider public.
DISCOVER.userperson: Travelers, locals, people with disabilities, local businesses
DISCOVER.personinteres: Travel and Tourism Discovering New and Hidden Places Nature, Culture, and Historical Sites Local Experiences Restaurants, Cafés, and Local Businesses Adventures and Activities Customer Recommendations and Reviews Accessible and Inclusive Tourism
DISCOVER.goal: Making it easier to discover hidden gems in Georgia Simplifying travel planning Sharing recommendations from real users Promoting local businesses Easily finding accessible locations
DISCOVER.geo: Tourism in Georgia is steadily growing; however, a large proportion of tourists mainly visit only well-known destinations.As a result:
DISCOVER.des: Small businesses in the regions often fail to reach potential customers because information about them is scattered or non-existent.
DISCOVER.infotitle: Local residents also often struggle to:</br> find new places for recreation; discover interesting spaces in the city; plan their free time.
DISCOVER.placeinfo: Georgia offers a multitude of unique places, natural landmarks, and cultural experiences, yet discovering them is difficult for consumers.
DISCOVER.lackof: Information is often unavailable to persons with disabilities regarding:</br>the presence of ramps; wheelchair accessibility; adapted spaces.
DISCOVER.new: 5. Difficulty adapting to a new environment
DISCOVER.newplace: People moving to a new city or neighborhood often lack information about:</br>nearby parks;  cafes; sports facilities; entertainment venues.

Fix.fixgeo: Fix Georgia is a digital platform that enables citizens to quickly and easily report urban infrastructure issues and convey information to the relevant municipality. The platform establishes a connection between citizens and local governments, facilitating the rapid identification, monitoring, and resolution of issues
Fix.problem: Commonly found in Georgian cities:</br> Damaged roads Malfunctioning street lighting Garbage accumulation Damaged public squares/parks Water leaks Damaged road signs Citizens often lack information on where and how to report these issues, which delays their resolution.

Kitchen.title: About the site
Kitchen.about: Kitchen is a restaurant website that allows users to easily browse the menu, search for a desired dish, and use filters to quickly find suitable options.
Kitchen.goal: The main goal of the site is to create a simple, fast and comfortable experience for the user, so that he can find the dish he wants and make a decision in the shortest possible time.
Kitchen.problem: Customers often struggle to quickly find the dish they want because menus offer so many choices, making it difficult to compare options. Additionally, a lack of sufficient information regarding prices, ingredients, and visual presentation complicates the decision-making process.

me.name: Natia Kasaburi
me.me: I am a Junior Front-End Developer and UI/UX Designer with both theoretical and practical knowledge in web development and digital design. In front-end development, I completed a course at IT Academy STEP, where I learned HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Angular. I have developed several independent web projects, which are showcased in my portfolio. I use GitHub and Vercel for version control and project deployment. I have experience using AI tools in the web development and design processes. I utilize AI as an assistant to develop ideas, generate and improve code, solve problems, and accelerate my workflow.</br> Regarding UI/UX design, I completed a training program at EduCity, during which I collaborated with a team on the Create Your Digital City  project. I received a certificate upon successfully completing the program. I have several independent projects created in Figma and am capable of handling the entire design process—from user personas and user flows to wireframes and final UI designs, as well as adding interactive prototypes and animations. My primary professional focus is creating digital products that combine strong visual design, a seamless user experience, and functional front-end implementation.
me.goalme: I would like to start my career as a Junior Front-End Developer or Junior UI/UX Designer, gain experience working in a real team, and develop my professional skills.
